_purpose: Byte-exact capture of the v0.8.1 LLM model pool. Rewrite core/llm_pool.py MUST default to this roster and assert import-time that every id resolves via databricks.sdk.serving.endpoints.get('databricks-<name>'). Forward-looking IDs (opus-4-7, haiku-4-5, gemma-3-12b) are FORBIDDEN in the baseline until the target workspace exposes them.
_notes: order is the routing priority within a (type, size) group (lower = higher priority).
llm_endpoint_name is the literal name passed to the FMAPI serving endpoint client.
llm_input_context_tokens_count and llm_output_context_tokens_count feed the context-ladder step-down (core/smart_worker_loop.py).
enabled=True is the default; ensemble auto-demotion (OPS-RUL-004) flips this to False in-memory after N failures — it MUST NOT be persisted back to the pool definition.
